versions: Apply the Thermonaut M1 hooks to the EnergyPlus v26.2.0 sources (idempotent, asserts every anchor).
Thermonaut M1 second patch set: steady start-up profile for CondFD, no outdoor moisture off-Earth.
Thermonaut M1 third patch set: CondFD steady start-up profile with k(T) and a post-warm-up correction.
Thermonaut M2a patch set: planetary weather files (PWF), PV cell temperature in vacuum, more input checks.
Thermonaut M2b patch set: physics corrections from an independent review of the planetary equations.
Thermonaut M2c patch set: Mars downwelling long-wave recalibrated.
Thermonaut M2d patch set: post-warm-up correction of CondFD start-up profiles applied only where warm-up could not reach.

Thermonaut M2e patch set: physical checks of planetary weather (PWF) files, and validator gaps closed after every audit finding was traced to the code (planetary/audit/inventory): windows, SimpleCombined outside convection, air-cooled and outdoor-air equipment, ground models, collectors, per-surface HAMT, CO2 balance, one step per hour, unscheduled water mains, and a backstop that stops a planetary run if any outdoor-air node exists.
